title: Delegation contract points at bee dispatch prepare
action: Two edits in the Delegation contract section, per D1(a) and D1(b). FIRST, the Transport bullet — line 130, opening `- **Transport** — \`subagent_type: bee-build|bee-gather|bee-extract|bee-review\` (the rendered agent file already IS its tier — generation/extraction/review — so naming it declares the tier and needs nothing else; prefer this shape)`. Rewrite its opening so the door is `.bee/bin/bee dispatch prepare --runtime <rt> --kind <cell|gather|reviewer|advisor> --json`: prepare reads the tier slot out of .bee/config.json and returns the tool plus the payload — a model-shaped slot returns an Agent/Task payload naming the rendered bee agent, a `{kind:"herding"}` slot returns a Bash `bee herding run` payload, a `{kind:"cli"}` slot returns a Bash external-executor payload. `subagent_type: bee-*` survives in the bullet only as what prepare RETURNS for a model-shaped slot and as a spelling the guard still accepts (per D2) — delete the words 'prefer this shape'. Keep the rest of the bullet (the tier-word list, the disagreement-repair sentence, the intent-sentence requirement, the no-worker-registration rule) intact. SECOND, the herding execution branch — lines 133-146, the bullet opening `- **herding execution branch** — \`bee herding run\` is the cell-execution mirror of the cli gather`. Its sentence `Boundary held exactly like \`cli\`'s: cell-execution-only, never a gather transport — a gather never dispatches through a herding pane (herding-executor D7, the mirror of the \`for_gather\` branch this same boundary already draws for \`cli\`).` is stale and must be retired: herding-tier D1-D6 (widened by herding-review-slots D1) routes every purpose against a `{kind:"herding"}` slot through `bee herding run`, and `bee dispatch prepare --kind gather` against such a slot returns a herding-exec Bash payload today. Replace it with the current rule and cite herding-tier D1-D6, naming herding-executor D7 as superseded so a later reader does not resurrect it. Do not restructure the section, renumber anything, or touch any other bullet.
verify: rg -n 'prefer this shape|a gather never dispatches through a herding pane' skills/bee-hive/references/gates-and-delegation.md; rg -n 'dispatch prepare' skills/bee-hive/references/gates-and-delegation.md
